discovery_notes: Follow-up 2 to packets 255/279 reusing their keys (checked 254/278/302: no overlap with new items). 30 standard searches, snippets only. New pins: Runaway Railway D23 Pluto (hold released; explains DPB's fifth pin), Loungefly Stitch Sitting (Dec 2021), WandaVision Unusual Couple (Jul 2021), Loungefly Child/Grogu Terrarium (Nov 2021), Loungefly Autumn Fun with Stitch (Aug 2021). Child with Frogs hold released (dedicated DPB post). Charcuterie Board moved to 2022. Makers for Runaway Railway, Haunted Mansion, Marvel/Star Wars singles still unstated.
